DIAGNOSIS READY: Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis.

The combination of psychiatric symptoms (paranoia), subacute cognitive decline, movement disorder (unsteady gait), and MRI findings of disseminated white matter lesions is highly characteristic of this autoimmune encephalitis, which can mimic MS. I recommend you undergo a full autoimmune encephalitis panel including NMDA receptor antibodies and a CT chest/abdomen/pelvis to rule out an underlying ovarian or lung teratoma.
